UserCloudProfile.title: UserCloudProfile
UserCloudProfile.description: Authenticated user's synced gallery preferences and account metadata

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user

displayName.description: Optional user display name from Google Sign-In

email.description: Optional user email from Google Sign-In (owner-only PII)

gridColumns.description: Synced default grid column count (2 to 5)

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

SyncedMediaItem.title: SyncedMediaItem
SyncedMediaItem.description: Cloud-synced favorite bookmark and personal note for a gallery photo or video

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user

mediaKey.description: Stable identifier for the gallery item

favorite.description: Whether the item is bookmarked as a favorite

note.description: Optional personal caption or memory note

dateTakenMs.description: Epoch milliseconds when media was captured

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

/users/{userId}.description: Stores per-user synced settings and account metadata

/users/{userId}/synced_items/{itemId}.description: Stores per-user cloud-synced favorites and photo/video notes
